item.title: WRE News: Miami Surpasses New York as the U.S. Capital of Million-Dollar Homes
item.description: Miami, FL - January 26, 2026 - Miami has officially overtaken New York as the nation’s epicenter of million-dollar homes, signaling a dramatic shift in where luxury real estate is concentrating. By the end of 2025, Miami surpassed New York City in active $1 million-plus listings, with 10,591 luxury properties on the market compared to New York’s 10,176, according to Realtor.com.
